divergences.description: The Code Map says bookmarkMessage() should rebuild messages by local id, the same way retryMessage does. Instead, ChatCubit adds an in-memory _bookmarkStateByServerId map and _fromDomain re-applies the recorded bookmark state when a session's history reloads. The final emit also matches messages by serverId instead of the local messageId. The effect is that a save which finishes after the user switches or starts a session still shows its saved/error result when they return.

divergences.description: bookmarkMessage() adds a cubit-level `_bookmarkStateByServerId` map, keyed by serverId. It records the saving/saved/error outcome and is re-applied in `_fromDomain` when a session's history reloads. The final emit also matches messages by serverId instead of the local message id. The Code Map only planned a per-message `for...if...else` rebuild by id, as in `retryMessage`. The change keeps a save result from being lost when the user switches sessions mid-save. The state stays in memory only.
